settings.title: How to assemble a JALG TV stand?

settings.text:
JALG TV stands are very easy to assemble and can completed by oneself in 5-10 minutes. However if you have a TV larger than 55” we recommend two people, larger TVs tend to be quite heavy.

For detailed assembly instructions, you can download PDF manuals with illustrated instructions below.

settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.text:
We ship worldwide via premium couriers. The shipment will be done either by DHL Standard/DHL Express, DPD (within EU only) or Omniva, depending on the location.
Delivery prices and time vary according to destination and the final price is calculated at checkout.

Please note that it may take up to 24 hours before you can track your order.
